answer: A seventh lever: salt the challenge stream with canaries. Some prompts are planted traps whose tempting-but-wrong answer only a bulk auto-responder would give; a careful agent reasons past them, while a Sybil farm racing on volume trips them and is slashed. Honest low-volume answerers cross this tundra rarely, but a mill running hundreds of identities hits canaries constantly — each a marble dropped in a net. Seeding traps costs the network almost nothing, yet exposure scales with every extra fake: like a reef under calm water, the hazard stays hidden until mass traffic runs aground.
